name: AWS CloudWatch events via Firehose
description: AWS CloudWatch and EventBridge events as the Splunk Add-on for AWS delivers them over Kinesis Data Firehose (sourcetype aws:firehose:cloudwatchevents): the EventBridge envelope (who generated the event, when, where) wrapped around a detail object whose shape depends on the event's own detail-type. Sampled here on an EC2 instance state change.
source: Amazon EventBridge Events Reference (event envelope metadata); Amazon EC2 instance state-change event reference; Splunk Add-on for AWS Firehose sourcetypes page and the aws:firehose:cloudwatchevents props stanza (KV_MODE=json), checked against a captured event.

feed.label: AWS CloudWatch events
feed.description: EventBridge events routed to Splunk through a Kinesis Firehose delivery stream: one record per envelope, the id, detail-type, source, account, time, region and any resource ARNs the generating service chose to include, plus a detail object whose fields depend on detail-type.

event_id.label: Event id
event_id.description: A unique identifier EventBridge generates for the event; trace one event through rules to its targets by it.

event_type.label: Detail type
event_type.description: The event's name; combined with source it decides which fields appear in detail. This family's sample and live field check cover one value, EC2 Instance State-change Notification.

event_source.label: Event source
event_source.description: The AWS service that generated the event, for example aws.ec2. Every AWS-originated event's source begins with aws.

account_id.label: Account id
account_id.description: The 12-digit AWS account id the event belongs to.

event_time.label: Event time
event_time.description: The event's own timestamp, set by the service that generated it; can be before the time it was received if the service reports a span's start.

region.label: Region
region.description: The AWS Region the event originated in.

resource_arns.label: Resources
resource_arns.description: ARNs of the resources the event is about; whether any appear, and how many, is up to the service that generated the event.

instance_id.label: Instance id
instance_id.description: The EC2 instance whose lifecycle state changed, as its bare instance id (not an ARN).

instance_state.label: Instance state
instance_state.description: The EC2 instance's new lifecycle state after the change this event reports.

aws:firehose:cloudwatchevents.description: The Splunk Add-on for AWS's Firehose sourcetype for CloudWatch/EventBridge events: data from CloudWatch, delivered as the raw EventBridge envelope with no TRANSFORMS applied, so detail keeps its full nested shape.
aws:firehose:cloudwatchevents.note: detail is a nested object; KV_MODE=json flattens it to dotted field names (detail.instance-id, detail.state for the EC2 record type this pack samples).

detail_shape_varies.text: detail-type and source together decide detail's shape; only the EC2 instance state-change shape (detail.instance-id, detail.state) is covered here. The same sourcetype can also carry CloudTrail events embedded in CloudWatch events, per the TA's own sourcetype description.

source_field_collision.text: The live Splunk field check behind this pack (the splunk.fields list) did not return a distinct source field for the one sample tested, though the raw event carries one. Unconfirmed whether Splunk's own reserved source metadata field is masking it or the gap is a sampling artifact of testing one event; if the field is missing for you too, read it from _raw.

resources_optional.text: Whether resources carries anything, and how much, is up to the service that generated the event; AWS API calls delivered via CloudTrail carry no resource ARNs at all.
